facts.business: E & E Enterprises Limited is engaged in the business of acquiring, undertaking, promoting, running, managing, owning, leasing, converting, building, hiring, letting on hire hotels, restaurants, café, rest houses and purchasing, selling or dealing in all types of movable or immovable properties for development, investment, leasing or for resale.
